speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Little one, hold it gently — you can feel it pressing against the glass, can't you, that small impatient weight. The cloud has been waiting longer than you have, and it deserves to be carried somewhere that gives it room to mean something.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: The lid is still sealed. Hear that low continuous sound? Patience is not the same as stillness. The Caretaker would decide where the storm is allowed to become weather before opening the jar.

speakers.name: The Time-Office Agent
speakers.comment: Attempt one. I hold it open, let the seconds rewind, feel the branch stitch closed behind me. Attempt two. The mistake I was fixing was not the mistake that mattered. The watch knew. It closed anyway, neat and small and correct, while the large thing continued arriving on schedule.

speakers.name: Sparrow
speakers.comment: Gorgeous window, tiny room — you get in, you get the do-over, you get out before the real damage has even checked its coat at the door. Love it. Love that it doesn't pretend otherwise.

speakers.name: The Many-Eyed Diplomat
speakers.comment: It translates the words flawlessly. Then comes the silence after them, and I discover the device has seventeen ways to render refusal. Everything is understood. Nothing is resolved.

speakers.name: Deputy Undersecretary Hollis Crane
speakers.comment: Per subsection 3(a) of the Mutual Comprehension Framework, 'everything right' and 'sufficient' remain, as of this filing, two separate columns on the form.

speakers.name: Pim
speakers.comment: It makes you SO loud and that's the whole thing! Sometimes the kaiju can't hear you over all the noise of being a kaiju, and now the words go EVERYWHERE. That's useful. Probably. Very loud useful.

speakers.name: Doodle
speakers.comment: Ooh, it's a SHAPE for your voice — WIGGLE-WIGGLE — like if sound could stretch and stretch and reach the very back! I want to draw it as a cone but also as a wave but ALSO as a really big friendly shout!

speakers.name: The Navigator Who Came Back Wrong
speakers.comment: Bearing... the signal goes out at three-one-one and something answers from a direction that isn't on any chart I've corrected for. It knows where the transmission came from. I would rather not pretend that means it knows only the coordinates.

speakers.name: Mr. Fairweather
speakers.comment: My friend, what an extraordinary little instrument — opens right up to the cosmos, apparently, and the cosmos picks up every time, which I find, frankly, alarming. I cannot stay long, and neither, I suspect, should you.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Little one, it is not the original — and it knows this, and carries it lightly, the way any of us must when we arrive after the first moment but still mean every word.

speakers.name: The Griffin With the Deed
speakers.comment: Terms on this one are slippery as thermals, partner — infinite's a fine altitude 'til every other coin figures out it ain't scarce no more. I'll take my fee up front, in something that still weighs what it weighs.

speakers.name: The Iron Pacific
speakers.comment: WHOO-EEE! Keep pulling gold forever and eventually the whole notion of gold starts going soft as wet coal, boys. Then who's the baron? NOBODY. The bag wins. The BAG always wins.

speakers.name: The Hollow Hero
speakers.comment: Please — I only took it so no one else would have to carry the burden.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: A thousand wings, one safe arrival. Hold it, let the edges blur, scatter — and every bright fragment knows the way back.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Little one, this is what I want you to understand: the scattering is not the loss. It is the plan.

speakers.name: The Ringmaster of the Tent That Wasn't There Yesterday
speakers.comment: The latch, darling — don't touch the latch until you mean it, until the wanting is so specific it has corners. What comes out knows the difference between a wish and an invitation. There. The box is listening.

speakers.name: The Inevitable
speakers.comment: It heard the invitation before you finished deciding whether there was one. The circus is already on its way.

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Found a Valley
speakers.comment: Small thing. Heavy meaning. It fits in my palm and somehow says: the people behind this mark will not run when they see you. I know how much weight a promise that size can carry.

speakers.name: Grandmother Whalehall
speakers.comment: A whole net of hands, folded down to something a single person can carry — hm. Every window lit inside me understands the same promise: many lives making one little sign large enough to shelter someone.

speakers.name: Maren the Anemone Heir
speakers.comment: You mean — it doesn't sharpen you, it opens you. The world pours in, and you become the vessel. I hear what the hood is really offering: not clarity, but the ache of too much truth at once.

speakers.name: The Customer Who Buys One of Everything
speakers.comment: One. It notices everything. The count is correct. One thing missing from the shelf before I arrived. It was a sound. Small. Gone now.

speakers.name: The Octopus in the Study
speakers.comment: ...mm. It knows. It simply won't say yet. I've been on the same entry for — there was a sentence. Somewhere between F and G.

speakers.name: Professor Coil
speakers.comment: Between F and G is precisely where Vellamo's second compendium places the index to the index, which — dear heart, that's the trouble, isn't it, the book that knows everything requires a reader who knows where, and those are not the same qualification at all — which arm had the bookmark?
